headline: Consolidated Finvest Shareholders Vote to Delist Shares from NSE
summary: Shareholders of Consolidated Finvest & Holdings have approved the proposal to delist the company's equity shares from the National Stock Exchange. The move will transition the company off the primary exchange platform, directly impacting trading access for existing investors. Public shareholders will lose open market liquidity on the NSE once the delisting process completes.
why_it_matters: Stock liquidity will drop significantly after removal from the exchange.
